# Colin Nies

> Software engineer at UKG focused on frontend development and UX. Works in the sweet spot between design and engineering, building products that look clean and feel special. Currently pursuing a Master's in Technology Management at Rutgers University.

## About

- Role: Software Engineer at [UKG](https://ukg.com)
- Focus: frontend development, UX, interaction design
- Education: Master's in Technology Management (in progress), Rutgers University
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
- Worked with: UKG, Daialog, GigFi, LendSwift, Union Square Financial, Lindy Promotions, Joonbug, Skynet Media
